# `/prd`

> Create or update the Product Requirements Document through guided discovery

<!-- generated by scripts/gen-command-docs.py from commands/prd.md — do not edit -->

Guided discovery interview that produces the Product Requirements Document.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Usage** | `/prd [update]` |
| **Reads** | existing `PRD.md` (update mode) |
| **Writes** | `PRD.md` (after you approve) |
| **Gates** | Five interview phases, each waits for your answers; the file is written only after approval. |
| **Next** | `/constitution` |
| **Tools** | `Bash(ls:*), Read, Write, Edit, Grep, Glob` |
